text:
Ana (partner-eng): Quick heads-up 1: we9re moving VectorSI + NimbusHW listing into the cloud marketplace intake. Need the minimum security bundle we can publish: SOC3 cover or redacted SOC2, pen-test exec summary, firmware integrity attestation, and a short evidence access plan. Target launch in ~4 weeks.
Ravi (security): Clarify: do we require full pen artifacts or will an executive summary + scope mapping suffice? Also ask whether tests were black-box only.
Ana (partner-eng): VectorSI says external web app + API; NimbusHW will provide firmware hashes. VectorSI prefers limited disclosure.
Sara (partner-ops): VectorSI legal flagged customer PII in raw reports. Their preference: either sanitized PDFs OR time-limited signed links (we can presign GCS or S3). They asked for our redaction checklist first.
Gab (infra): We can accept either. If using GCS signed URLs the sample command is: `gsutil signurl -d 7d /path/to/key.json gs://vectorsi-uploads/pen-summary.pdf` or aws presign if S3. TTL 7 days recommended.
Tom (legal): If they send sanitized PDFs we need an attestation letter from their security lead confirming redactions. If they want us to access raw reports, we need an NDA addendum and an auditable access log.
Ravi (security): For SOC2, we'll accept: cover letter, auditor opinion, and a short control narrative for change management and access controls. Everything else redacted. I'll draft an "accepted sections" list.
Ana (partner-eng): Nice. Can we also ask for a mapping doc that ties VectorSI's pen items to our risk taxonomy? That speeds review.
Sara (partner-ops): I'll prepare a 1-page redaction template we can share with VectorSI legal. It will include required fields and examples of allowed redactions (e.g., customer names -> [REDACTED]).
Gab (infra): From infra: we need the KMS key alias used for artifact encryption, a statement about log retention period for access to artifacts, and a public key if they sign firmware metadata. I'll drop sample snippets.
compliance-bot: Created ticket PM-902: "VectorSI marketplace evidence + redaction template" (owner: Ravi). Due in 4 business days.
Ravi (security): I'll post the allowed-sections list + a short mapping template by EOD tomorrow.
Tom (legal): I'll draft the attestation blurb we want in writing from their security lead if they provide sanitized bundles.
Ana (partner-eng): Action items: Sara -> redaction one-pager; Gab -> KMS/log snippets; Ravi -> allowed-sections + mapping; Tom -> attestation text. I9ll compile and send to VectorSI.
Sara (partner-ops): Ack. Also propose weekly 20min triage (Tues 9am PT) until we close artifacts.
Gab (infra): Ack 1. Will post example KMS policy and a sample presign TTL recommendation.
Ravi (security): One more ask: request firmware manifest with SHA256 hashes and a signed attestation (PEM) for NimbusHW images. If they can provide a reproducible build script hash that9s even better.
Ana (partner-eng): Good catch. Add that to the artifact list I send. Also note fallback: if VectorSI refuses presigned links we accept sanitized bundle + signed attestation from their CISO.
Tom (legal): If they need expedited access to raw docs, we can offer a time-boxed review in a secure review VM under NDA addendum. Will advise on language.
Sara (partner-ops): I'll include an example redaction PDF and a checklist for reviewers so VectorSI legal can self-validate before sending.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 72 hours for ticket PM-902.
Ana (partner-eng): Thanks team. Please post your artifacts/templates here (presigned links only). If anyone wants to loop in Marketplace GTM for announcement cadence, ping me and I9ll add them. :rocket:
